body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes navigation to named object views (e.g. calendar/kanban) by (1) preserving `viewName` in generated hrefs and (2) ensuring `listViews` survives `defineStack()` validation so the console can resolve the correct view type instead of falling back to the default grid.

**Changes:**
- Add `viewName?: string` to `NavigationItem` and its Zod schema.
- Append `/view/${viewName}` to object navigation hrefs across layout + console entry points, plus a layout unit test.
- Re-merge stack-level `views[].listViews` into validated objects after `defineStack()` (console MSW mode + server/dev config).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/app.ts | Adds `viewName` to `NavigationItem` type so apps can declare a target named view. |
| packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts | Updates Zod validation to preserve `viewName` in navigation configs. |
| packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx | Updates `resolveHref()` to include `/view/<viewName>` for object nav items. |
| packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx | Updates mobile bottom nav href generation to include `/view/<viewName>`. |
| packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.test.tsx | Adds a unit test covering `viewName` href generation in `NavigationRenderer`. |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Updates initial home redirect route selection to include `viewName` when present. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Updates console mobile bottom nav links to include `/view/<viewName>`. |
| apps/console/src/components/SearchResultsPage.tsx | Updates search result hrefs for object items to include `/view/<viewName>`. |
| apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts | Applies `defineStack()` first, then re-merges `listViews` back into validated objects (MSW/browser). |
| objectstack.config.ts | Adds merged `views` to the validated stack and re-merges `listViews` into objects after `defineStack()` (server/dev). |
</details>

This change re-merges `listViews` after `defineStack()` (`objects: mergeViewsIntoObjects(validated.objects || [], allConfigs)`), but `sharedConfig.objects` already ran `mergeViewsIntoObjects()` before validation. Since `defineStack()` strips `listViews`, the pre-merge is now redundant work and makes the pipeline harder to follow. Consider constructing `sharedConfig.objects` without `listViews` and applying `mergeViewsIntoObjects()` only once after validation.

There’s test coverage for href generation in `packages/layout/src/__tests__/AppSchemaRenderer.test.tsx`, but no test asserting the new `viewName` → `/view/<name>` behavior for the mobile bottom nav. Adding a focused test would help prevent regressions since href logic is duplicated across multiple components.

`SearchResultsPage` builds object hrefs using `${baseUrl}/${item.objectName}` without checking that `objectName` exists. Navigation configs produced by the designer can include `type: 'object'` items without `objectName`, which would cause these results to show up with `/apps/<app>/undefined` (and possibly `/view/...` appended). Consider only creating an href when `objectName` is present (otherwise keep `'#'` so it gets filtered out).
```suggestion
      if (item.type === 'object' && item.objectName) {
```
